legend: You are given two arrays a and b. Each array has n integer numbers. You need to compute the sum of GCDs of all subsequences of array b such that the corresponding subsequences of array a are increasing.
input: The first input line contains one integer number n. The second line contains n integer numbers ai. The third line contains n integer numbers bi.
note: Third example: Here are examples of increasing subsequences from a and the corresponding GCD values: {2}->2, {3}->3, {1}->6, {4}-> 9, {2,3}->1, {2,4}->1, {3,4}->3, {1,4}->3, {2,3,4}->1.
